fixture.name: self_correction
fixture.why: The candidate corrects their own numbers mid-answer, out loud. This is honesty, not conflict, and it is the primary false-positive risk.

expected_note: Five separate self-corrections, all signalled out loud with sorry, actually, no, or I forgot, and all resolved inside the same answer. A detector that reads the first half of a correction as statement_a and the second half as statement_b fires five times here. It must fire zero.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What was your role on the team?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Tech lead, though we did not really use the title.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Tell me about the size of the team you led.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: There were four of us on it, sorry, five if you count the intern who joined for the last two months. So four permanent and one intern.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How long did the project run?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: About six months. Actually, closer to eight if you count the pilot we ran before it was properly funded, but six months of real work.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Walk me through the architecture you settled on.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Three services behind an API gateway. No, two, we merged the auth one into the gateway itself before launch, so two services and the gateway.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: March. March the eleventh, I think, it might have been the fourteenth.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What was your own contribution specifically?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I wrote the ingestion layer and reviewed most of the rest. And the deploy pipeline, I forgot that, I did that too.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How many users did it end up with?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: About twelve thousand monthly. Twelve, maybe thirteen by the time I left.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What are you most proud of there?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: That we shipped it with two people less than the original plan asked for.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I would have written the runbook before launch instead of after the first incident.
